'''''Dagger''''' was a starship in the service of the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], it was sent with a complement of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] under the command of [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] to safeguard [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]] in the wake of a [[Battle of Kothlis (Clone Wars)|Separatist invasion]] there, before being sent to participate in an [[Battle of Lanteeb|assault]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lanteeb/Legends|Lanteeb]].
